descriptions.it: WHO WE NEED We are looking for ambitious talents who will become the shapers of the new reborn legendary hotel in one of the most prestigious alpine resorts in the world. Are you expecting more than a job? Then let’s GRACE together! WHAT WILL YOU DO? ● Proactively identify, approach and win new groups, weddings, conferences, incentives, banquets and private-event business – you hunt for business, not just process enquiries ● Lead client consultations end-to-end: understand the brief, shape the concept, build the proposal, quote it and negotiate terms ● Negotiate contracts and rates directly with clients, agents and corporate bookers, and close the deal – you carry your own pipeline and revenue targets ● Build and manage event budgets, control costs and margins, and report on conversion and revenue performance ● Partner closely with F&B leadership and the kitchen on menus, service concepts and pricing so every proposal is commercially and operationally sound before it goes to the client ● Be the single point of contact for the client from contract signature through planning, execution and post-event follow-up ● Coordinate and brief all departments involved in delivery – F&B, kitchen, housekeeping, engineering, spa, security – and external vendors (decorators, technicians, entertainment) ● Act as on-site host during groups and events, resolving issues in real time and protecting the guest experience and the hotel's reputation ● Plan and dispatch off-site and private catering – private residences, private jets, transfers and boutique locations – in coordination with F&B ● Keep the department's point-of-sale, offer templates and booking processes current, both on-site and for secondary locations ● Work with marketing on positioning, packages and promotion of the groups & events offering to attract new clientele ● Ensure every event complies with health, safety and legal requirements, and uphold GRACE's quality standards throughout ● Continuously refine SOPs and processes for
